newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 23.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

* Blue-chip stocks rallied to a record closing high in one of Wall Street's busiest days on Friday despite a proposed landmark settlement with U.S. state negotiators that depressed tobacco shares. The Dow Jones industrial average finished up 19.45 points at 7,796.51, off its session high of 7,834.

* Indonesia's central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono told Reuters in an interview that Indonesia is working to make the country's banking sector more competitive and is aware of some problems in the industry. He said the bank felt it could only manage the economy successfully if the banking industry was flourishing.
* Indonesia will announce a deregulation package in July which will contain regulations to avoid double taxation by central and regional governments.
* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index ended 0.53 points up at 712.22 points as strong sentiment in the automotive and agribusiness sectors helped the index rebound in late trading, brokers said.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,430.50/31.00 at 0130 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,430.50/31.50.
* Banking stocks such as Bank Danamon, Bank International Indonesia, Bank Bali on market talk that they might have to support the national car project.
* Property firm Duta Anggada on an announcement that it posted first quarter net profit of 25.09 billion rupiah, almost double the 1996 first quarter figure of 12.91 billion rupiah.
* Cocoa butter producer Davomas on media reports that it has postponed plans for an alliance with a European firm as it decided to focus on increasing production capacity.
* Medco Energy on reports that it will propose a rights issue valued at 300 billion rupiah to finance an expansion programme.
* Retailer Matahari Putra Prima ahead of its shareholders meeting in the afternoon.
* Pulp and paper maker Indah Kiat Pulp and Paper IKPP.JK ahead of a shareholders general meeting which is likely to discuss a proposed rights issue.
